figurative_meaning_bn: আর্তনাদ; ভয়, বিস্ময়, দুঃখ ইত্যাদি ভাব
figurative_meaning_en: Exclamation of distress; expressions of fear, surprise, sorrow, etc.
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাবারে বাবা, এত বড় ক্ষতি হয়েছে!
example_sentences_in_english: Oh father! What a terrifying accident!
Father's father! Such a huge loss has occurred!
note: This idiom is a common exclamatory phrase in Bengali, often used informally to express shock or dismay.
